items.q: How does TinaVerify™ prevent payment fraud and screenshot spoofing?
items.a: TinaVerify intercepts transfer receipts and cross-references transaction reference IDs, sender data, and amounts against banking webhooks. It rejects fake SMS alerts and reused reference codes automatically, ensuring no bill can be marked as paid until the money is confirmed.

items.q: What hardware is required for station displays (Kitchen, Barista, Pastry)?
items.a: Zero specialized hardware required. Fanaye runs as a modern, high-performance PWA on standard touchscreens, iPads, Android tablets, or all-in-one POS monitors. Stations update in real-time via WebSocket event streaming with audio alerts.

items.q: What happens if our restaurant loses internet connection during dinner service?
items.a: Fanaye is built with an offline-first architecture. Waiters can continue taking orders and issuing checks locally on their tablets. When connectivity is restored, the local event queue synchronizes deterministically with the cloud database without losing a single ticket.

items.q: How does the Waiter Cash Drop workflow work with the Cashier Desk?
items.a: Waiters collect cash from customers at the table. To prevent carrying high cash amounts, waiters record digital cash drops directly on their app. The Cashier verifies and accepts the custody in their drawer. The shift report attributes every dollar to the specific waiter, shift, and table session.

items.q: Can fulfillment stations be customized without altering waiter menu flows?
items.a: Yes. Stations (Kitchen, Barista, Pastry/Cakes, Soft Drinks) are configurable tenant data. You can reroute specific categories or disable a station during off-peak hours without changing how waiters enter orders.

items.q: How quickly can new waitstaff and cashiers be trained?
items.a: Fanaye was built with touch-first ergonomics and clear visual cues. Most waitstaff master table ordering and TinaVerify scans in under 15 minutes of hands-on training.
